question: Do you have photos of the four hands massage? I'd like to see it before booking.

answer.text: You will find photos of the four-hands massage on our website {website}.
answer.translation: Anda akan menemukan foto pijat empat tangan di situs web kami {website}.

callToAction.text: Please let us know whenever you are ready.
callToAction.translation: Silakan beri tahu kami kapan pun Anda siap.
